# compelem-router

> A router library for CompElem — declarative routing for Web Components with hash mode, nested routes, and navigation guards.

## Docs

- [README](./README.md) - Installation, usage, and API reference (Chinese)
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/holyhigh2/compelem-router) - Source code and issues

## Features

- Hash mode routing based on `location.hash`
- Nested routes with `children` configuration
- Path syntax: static segments, dynamic `:id`, regex `:id{\d+}`, optional `?:id`, wildcard `*`
- Redirect and fallback routes
- Named routes with `name` + `params` / `query` navigation
- Navigation guards: global (`beforeEach`/`beforeResolve`/`afterEach`), route-level (`beforeEnter`), component-level (`routeEnter`/`routeUpdate`/`routeLeave`)
- `<l-router-link>` component with automatic active class
- Reactive route state with `useRoute()`

## Quick Start

```ts
import { CompElem, defineComponents, h, tag } from 'compelem'
import { createRouter, outlet } from 'compelem-router'

@tag('app-root')
export class App extends CompElem {
  constructor() {
    super()
    createRouter({
      mode: 'hash',
      routes: [
        { path: '/', redirect: '/home' },
        { path: '/home', component: HomeComp, name: 'Home' },
        { path: '/user/:id', component: UserComp },
        { path: '*', redirect: '/' }
      ]
    })
  }

  render() {
    return h`<div>
      <nav>
        <l-router-link .to="/home">Home</l-router-link>
      </nav>
      ${outlet()}
    </div>`
  }
}

defineComponents()
```

## API

### createRouter(options: RouterOption): Router

Create a router instance.

| Option | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mode` | `RouterMode` | `'hash'` (currently supported) |
| `routes` | `RouteItem[]` | Route table |
| `beforeEach` | `(to, from) => Promise<boolean>` | Global before each guard |
| `beforeResolve` | `(to, from) => Promise<boolean>` | Global before resolve guard |
| `afterEach` | `(to, from) => void` | Global after each hook |

### useRouter(): Router

Get the router instance (singleton).

| Method | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `push(route)` | Navigate with new history entry |
| `replace(route)` | Navigate replacing current entry |
| `back()` | Go back |
| `forward()` | Go forward |
| `go(delta)` | Go delta steps |

### outlet(): Directive

Route content outlet directive for rendering matched components.

### useRoute(): Route

Get reactive current route information.

### onRouteChange(cb): () => void

Subscribe to route changes, returns unsubscribe function.
